Ninuy Akinu}}, [[Jawi Alphabet|Jawi]]: ايڠايد نو سناتور نينوي اكينو), is a [[municipality of the Philippines|municipality]] in the [[Philippine Province|province]] of [[Sultan Kudarat]], [[Philippines]]. According to the 2024 census, it has a population of 48,003 people.{{PH wikidata|population_reference}} ==History== Senator Ninoy Aquino was established on February 17, 1989, through [[Republic Act]] No. 6712. The municipality is named after former senator [[Ninoy Aquino|Benigno "Ninoy" Aquino Jr.]], who was [[Assassination of Ninoy Aquino|assassinated in 1983]]. The creation of the municipality involved transferring several barangays from neighboring municipalities: Buenaflores, Bugso, Kiadsam, Kadi, Kulaman, Malegdeg and Sewod from the municipality of [[Kalamansig]] and Langgal from the municipality of [[Bagumbayan, Sultan Kudarat|Bagumbayan]] to form the new municipality. The seat of government of the municipality is designated at Barangay Kulaman.{{cite PH act|chamber=RA|number=6712|title=An Act Creating the Municipality of Senator Ninoy Aquino in the Province of Sultan Kudarat|url=https://lawyerly.ph/laws/view/l1949|website=House of Representatives of the Philippines|accessdate=November 1, 2024|date= February 17, 1989}} ==Geography== ===Barangays=== Senator Ninoy Aquino is politically subdivided into 20 [[barangay]]s.
